articles.title: Nasha Mukt Jammu & Kashmir: A Historic 100-Day Campaign to Protect Youth of Jammu and Kashmir
articles.summary: Drug addiction has emerged as a serious social challenge affecting the youth of Jammu & Kashmir. The alarming spread of narco-related issues threatens the region's social fabric and stability, demanding urgent, multi-faceted intervention. Addressing this menace is crucial for national security, internal peace, and the overall development of youth in this strategically vital area.

articles.title: Manitoba touts improvements since wildfires killed 2, displaced 33,000 in 2025
articles.summary: An interim report on Manitoba's (Canada) 2025 wildfire season notes provincial improvements since last year's devastating fires, which killed two and displaced 33,000 people. While progress has been made in disaster response and management, the report reportedly does not fully examine the province's comprehensive preparedness for future wildfire events, indicating areas for further scrutiny despite the implemented changes.

articles.title: Table for Mom: OpenTable Launches Mother’s Day Dining Trends and Canada’s Top 100 Brunch and Lunch Restaurants for 2026
articles.summary: OpenTable has unveiled its Top 100 Brunch and Lunch Restaurants for 2026, specifically curated for celebrating mothers across Canada. The extensive list caters to diverse preferences, featuring 54 unique establishments highlighted for their exceptional offerings. This guide aims to help Canadians discover ideal dining experiences to honor the important women in their lives, providing a comprehensive selection nationwide.

articles.title: Table for Mom: OpenTable Launches Mother’s Day Dining Trends and Canada’s Top 100 Brunch and Lunch Restaurants for 2026
articles.summary: A significant 65% of Canadians consider dining out an essential part of their Mother's Day celebrations. Interestingly, nearly a quarter (23%) of mothers indicated they would consider dining alone at a restaurant for the occasion. This trend reveals evolving preferences in how Canadian families mark this special day, highlighting both traditional communal gatherings and an increasing acceptance of individual dining experiences for mothers.

articles.title: BEML wins major ₹590 crore order from Defence Ministry for T-72 and T-90 tank trawls
articles.summary: BEML Limited, a public sector enterprise under the Ministry of Defence, has secured a significant ₹590 crore contract from the Ministry of Defence. This award strengthens India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities and commitment to 'Atmanirbhar Bharat'. For SSB aspirants, this highlights ongoing modernization and domestic procurement efforts, ensuring a robust future for the Indian armed forces and associated industries.

articles.title: This New 213-Foot Explorer Yacht Concept Can Be Configured for Work or Play
articles.summary: Canada-based ER Yacht Design has unveiled a new 213-foot superyacht concept, an explorer vessel built for remote adventures. Described as a 'triple threat,' this innovative luxury yacht showcases cutting-edge marine design and engineering. It highlights advancements in naval architecture, combining advanced capabilities with opulence for high-end recreational travel.
